title: 6 拳出如牛7 妖魔之说
content_zh:
天色渐亮。
入冬后，白天的时间短了许多。
林哲羽已经站了将近一个时辰，脸色发红，气息微喘，看起来尚有余力。
“可以了。”
梁松说道，让他过来喝口茶。
林哲羽直起身，甩了甩略微发酸的双腿和手臂，脸上露出兴奋的笑容。
成了。
他终于能够练武了。
“基础那么差，一个月内能锻炼到这种程度，毅力和悟性都不错。”
梁松评价道，对林哲羽还算满意。
他喝了口茶，继续道：“先给你讲讲何为武道吧。”
林哲羽安静地坐着，听得极为认真。
“所谓武道，外练筋骨皮，内练一口气。”
“想要练好武功，首先需要打熬皮肉筋膜。”
“通过打熬皮肉筋膜，使得肌肉结实饱满，筋肉强健有力，筋膜伸缩强劲，爆发力量凶猛，抗击打能力强，这是武道的练肉期。”
“练好皮膜筋肉后，继而深入锻骨。”
“锻骨由外而内，淬炼浑身骨骼，让骨骼越发坚硬强健，洞穿力强，能够承受更强大的力量爆发。”
“骨骼练至大成，能炼骨如铁，坚硬无比！”
“锻骨对你来说有点难度，没有经历过小时候的筋骨打熬，想要达到练骨如铁很难很难。”
“上面所说是外练筋骨皮，接下来说说内练一口气。”

“这里所说的气是指呼吸吐纳，经过筋骨皮的打熬后，对于身体的掌控进一步提升，能够开始修炼特殊的呼吸吐纳术。”
“通过特殊的呼吸吐纳术，能够使得五脏內腑淬炼变强，呼吸悠远绵长，体力爆发力、耐力达到极为恐怖的层次，这是炼脏。”
“武道前三境，练肉、锻骨、炼脏。”
“对于你现在来说，知道武道前三境就差不多了，后面的境界离你还很远，就先不告诉你了，免得你好高骛远。”
梁松淡淡道。
他站起身，脱下披着的外衣，露出里头的背心和流畅的肌肉线条。
林哲羽见状，连忙起身跟上。
“内城不宜动刀兵，就教伱蛮牛拳吧。”
“这是一门流传极广的功法，适合你这种半路练武的。拳法威力不错，但易学难精。”
“练到高深之处，内强外壮，骨骼坚硬，能够达到炼脏境圆满。”
“蛮牛拳一共八招基础拳法，128招变招，我打一遍，你先熟悉下。”
梁松摆开架势说道。
林哲羽发现，梁松认真起来后，跛脚跟没事人一样。
“蛮牛拳蛮牛拳，这是一门脱胎于蛮牛的拳法。”
“拳法中的精髓奥义是蛮字，锻炼时，要将自己想象成一头蛮牛，出拳要一往无前，无所畏惧。”
content_en:
It's getting light.
After winter, the days become much shorter.
Lin Zheyu had been standing for nearly an hour, his face was red, he was breathing slightly, and he seemed to still have some energy left.
"That's it."
Liang Song said, asking him to come over and have a sip of tea.
Lin Zheyu straightened up, shook his slightly sore legs and arms, and showed an excited smile on his face.
It’s done.
He was finally able to practice martial arts.
"The basics are so poor, but to be able to train to this level within a month shows great perseverance and understanding."
Liang Song commented that he was quite satisfied with Lin Zheyu.
He took a sip of tea and continued: "First, let me tell you what martial arts is."
Lin Zheyu sat quietly and listened extremely carefully.
"The so-called martial arts is to train the muscles, bones and skin externally, and to train the breath internally."
"If you want to practice martial arts well, you first need to attack the skin and fascia."
"By beating the skin and fascia, the muscles will be strong and full, the muscles will be strong and powerful, the fascia will stretch strongly, the explosive power will be fierce, and the ability to resist blows will be strong. This is the muscle training period of martial arts."
"After training the skin and muscles, you can then go deep into training the bones."
"Bone training works from the outside in to temper the bones throughout the body, making them harder and stronger, with strong penetrating power and capable of withstanding stronger bursts of force."
"When you train your bones to perfection, you can make them as strong as iron, making them extremely hard!"
"Bone training is a bit difficult for you. If you haven't experienced the torture of your muscles and bones as a child, it will be very difficult to achieve the goal of training your bones like iron."
"The above is about practicing the muscles, bones and skin externally. Next, let's talk about the internal training of one breath."
"The qi mentioned here refers to breathing and breathing. After the muscles, bones and skin are tempered, the control of the body is further improved, and you can start to practice special breathing and breathing techniques."
"Through the special breathing technique, the internal organs can be tempered and strengthened, the breathing can be long and long, and the physical explosiveness and endurance can reach extremely terrifying levels. This is refining the internal organs."
"The first three realms of martial arts are meat training, bone training, and organ training."
"For you now, it's enough to know the first three realms of martial arts. The latter realms are still far away from you, so I won't tell you now to avoid you being too ambitious."
Liang Song said calmly.
He stood up and took off his coat, revealing the vest and smooth muscle lines underneath.
Lin Zheyu saw this and quickly stood up to follow.
"It's not appropriate to use weapons in the inner city, so let's teach Monkey Boxing."
"This is a widely circulated martial art, suitable for mid-level martial arts practitioners like you. The boxing technique is very powerful, but it is easy to learn but difficult to master."
"Practice to a high level, become strong internally and externally, and have hard bones, and you can reach the perfection of the internal organs refining state."
"Manniu Fist has a total of eight basic moves and 128 variations. I'll do it once, and you can get familiar with it first."
Liang Song put on his posture and said.
Lin Zheyu discovered that after Liang Song became serious, he was as lame as a normal person.
"Manniu Fist, Manniu Fist, this is a boxing technique derived from Manniu."
"The essence of boxing is the word "barbarian". When exercising, you should imagine yourself as a barbarian bull. You should punch forward without fear."
